title: Reconstructing the EUV Spectrum of Star-forming Regions from Millimeter Recombination Lines of H I, He I, and He II
question: Can the EUV spectrum (13.6-54.4 eV slope and above) of star-forming regions be reconstructed from mm recombination lines H30a, He30a and He+48a, and does it agree with Starburst99 and BPASS models?

data.angular_resolution: Cycle 2: 0.53''x0.47'' (1.24''x0.93'' for the first Sgr B2(M) run); Cycle 4: ~0.3''x0.28''
data.sensitivity: Cycle 2: 2 mJy/beam; Cycle 4: 0.4 mJy/beam in a 10 km/s channel

what.value: Line emissivities of H30a, He+48a at n~1e4 cm-3, T~1e4 K
Effective charge Z_eff=1.0002 for He30a emissivity scaling

evidence.quote: assume $Z_\mathrm{eff}= 1.0002$ for the effective charge of the nucleus (cite: Towle96)

what.value: Target selection and classification of the ultra-compact HII regions

evidence.quote: The three ultra-compact HII regions are taken from the survey of (cite: 2010MNRAS.405.1560M).

recipe.method: Image with CASA, identify line-free channels, uv-plane continuum subtraction to get line and continuum cubes

recipe.goal: Extract spectra and fit recombination lines
recipe.method: Spectra from sub-regions and tot_H30a region; fit Gaussian/Voigt profiles to get V, DeltaV and integrated flux, excluding molecular lines; HI fitted first and subtracted when HeI sits on its wing
Assume V and width equal to He30a and fit the expected profile to uncontaminated data points

recipe.goal: Derive EM, Q and EUV slopes
recipe.method: Convert line fluxes to emission measures (eq. SdVtoEM), then to Q0,Q1,Q2 via recombination coefficients, then solve for gamma, L0, gamma_2 of a broken power law
assumptions: Radiation equilibrium, no EUV photon escape, no photon stealing by lower-threshold species; T=1e4 K

recipe.method: Compare gamma and Q with Starburst99 v7.0.1 and BPASS v2.2.1 (binary and single) for 1e3 Msun instantaneous starburst as a function of age

evidence.quote: The spectral slope $\gamma$ obtained for G328.8076 is $\sim 7.5$.
The temperature estimates for the observed extraction regions obtained this way are between 5,000 K to 12,000 K

not_stated_but_needed: line-free channel ranges used for uvcontsub
flux calibrator and flux scale uncertainty
how He+48a upper limits were computed (confidence level)
how <gamma> and its 0.4 uncertainty were averaged
score_reason: Analytic equations are fully given and data available, but imaging parameters and extraction regions are unspecified.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, explicit equations, and numeric results in Table 1, though imaging details are loosely specified.
